title: Electrical Engineer II – Semiconductor Equipment
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 


What We Offer


Salary:

$100,000.00 - $136,500.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

 

 

As an Electrical Engineer, you are responsible for designing, modifying, and troubleshooting electrical or electronic engineering assemblies, layouts, schematics, and drawings to advance the equipment that supports our technology. Using your technical experience and critical thinking skills, you will perform engineering analysis, generate test reports, develop innovative solutions, and create documentation for product releases. You will also coordinate the procurement and assembly of components, identify sources of critical parts, and resolve technical issues to ensure peak performance.

 

 

Summary

Applied Materials is seeking a Junior Electrical Engineer to support the definition and specification of next-generation 300 mm wafer-level substrate processing equipment. This role focuses on early-stage electrical architecture, safety systems, and tool-level control concepts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, review, and support AC and DC electrical distribution systems for industrial equipment and machinery.
  • Interpret and maintain electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts.
  • Perform panel assembly support, field wiring verification, and integration of industrial electrical components.
  • Troubleshoot electrical circuits ranging from simple control circuits to moderately complex industrial systems.
  • Support the implementation and commissioning of control systems, including sensors, actuators, relays, power supplies, and PLC-based equipment.
  • Select, install, and troubleshoot industrial connectors, terminal blocks, cable assemblies, and panel wiring components.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including mechanical, controls, manufacturing, and service engineers.
  • Assist with system validation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions for electrical and controls-related issues.
  • Support documentation updates, engineering change requests, and design improvements.
  • Follow applicable electrical standards, safety practices, and company engineering procedures.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AC and DC power distribution systems.
  • Understanding of industrial control systems and electrical control circuits.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with industrial connectors, panel wiring, cable routing, and electrical integration.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot electrical systems from basic to moderately complex circuits.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Preferred

  • Experience with semiconductor equipment or industrial tools
  • Exposure to system-level architecture definition

Additional Information
